label: For every omniscient wholly good being, every occurring intense suffering it could prevent has an…
paraphrase: For every omniscient wholly good being, every occurring intense suffering it could prevent has an unavoidable greater-good loss or equal/worse evil cost of prevention. This is a necessary condition only, in Rowe’s published simplified form.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: Through Rowe's core: with refined gratuitous suffering this constraint yields STMT-ROWE-NO-THEISTIC-BEING, whose own plan names the remaining bearer bridge (IsGod g gives Omniscient, Omnipotent and WhollyGood of g on a carrier shared with Rowe's signature). The constraint itself still needs warrant: the trolley batch only relocates it into a WHOLLY_GOOD_1 standard and an outcome bridge over a free comparison, which adds none.
connection_plan.blocker: The bearer bridge of STMT-ROWE-NO-THEISTIC-BEING is unbuilt (issue #1735). No warranted standard for divine permitting is recorded on Rowe's signature: the comparison used by the relocation has no axiology, and the classical permission rule (ST I q.2 a.3 ad 1) has not been encoded there. Divine permission versus intention is owned by issue #1456.
